public.pir_catalog.info_record_number: SAP purchasing info record number. The identifier of this contracted price.
public.pir_catalog.product_number: SAP material number, 18 chars zero-padded. 100% populated, and the reliable way to find a material here since material_description mostly is not.
public.pir_catalog.material_description: Material description. ONLY 33% POPULATED - search product_number as well, and do not treat a blank as meaning the material does not exist.
public.pir_catalog.material_group: UNUSED: entirely empty in the loaded data. Do not filter on it.
public.pir_catalog.suppliers_account_number: SAP supplier code. The SAME code as ai.sourcing.supplier_code in sourceguide_db and sns_record.supplier_id.
public.pir_catalog.plant: UNUSED in practice: only ~1% populated. Do not filter on it.
public.pir_catalog.country: Country of the info record: KSA, Egypt, Oman, Dubai, Iraq and others. A different vocabulary again from sourceguide_db.
public.pir_catalog.order_unit: Unit the price is quoted per.
public.pir_catalog.numerator_for_conversion: Conversion factor between order unit and base unit.
public.pir_catalog.unit_price: Contracted unit price in currency_key. There is NO pre-converted USD column here - join currency on code for usd_rate and multiply. Never convert with your own rate.
public.pir_catalog.currency_key: Currency of unit_price. Join to currency.code for usd_rate.
public.pir_catalog.standard_qty: Standard order quantity the price assumes.
public.pir_catalog.shipping_instructions: Shipping instructions recorded on the info record.
public.pir_catalog.minimum_remaining_shelf_life: Minimum shelf life required on delivery.
public.pir_catalog.valid_till_expiry_date: Date this contracted price stops being valid. Check it before quoting the price as current.
public.pir_catalog.expiring_in: Bucketed validity: 'Expired', '1 Month', '2 Month', '3 Month', '+3 Month'. The quickest way to answer what is about to lapse.
public.pir_catalog.status: 'Active' or 'Expired'. ONLY 847 of 4,807 rows are Active - 3,960 are Expired. ALWAYS filter on this or show it. Quoting an expired price as current is the main way to be wrong with this table.
public.pir_catalog.deletion_flag: UNUSED: entirely empty in the loaded data.
public.pir_catalog.material_supplier: Composite material and supplier key built by the source.
public.pir_catalog.material_supplier_org: Composite material, supplier and purchasing organisation key.
public.pir_catalog.synced_at: When this row was last synced from SAP. Operational metadata, not business data.

public.supplier_directory.code: SAP supplier code. Same codes as sourceguide_db and the SNS registry.
public.supplier_directory.name: Supplier name.
public.supplier_directory.emails: Contact email(s). 5,120 of 8,365 rows have one. A SECOND source of supplier contacts beyond the AVL - worth checking when ai.sourcing has no email, but say where the address came from.

public.currency.code: ISO currency code. Join target for pir_catalog.currency_key.
public.currency.usd_rate: Multiplier to convert this currency to USD. unit_price * usd_rate gives USD. This is the ONLY sanctioned conversion for pir_catalog.

public.catalog_entry.supplier_id: Supplier, joins to supplier.id (not the SAP code directly).
public.catalog_entry.uom_id: Unit of measure, joins to unit_of_measure.id.
public.catalog_entry.sirion_contract_id: Contract reference in Sirion, the contract management system.
public.catalog_entry.sirion_url: Link to the contract in Sirion.
public.catalog_entry.current_version_no: Current rate version. Join rate_version on entry_id and version_no for the live price.

public.rate_version.entry_id: The catalog_entry this price belongs to.
public.rate_version.version_no: Version number. The live one is catalog_entry.current_version_no.
public.rate_version.unit_price: Unit price for this version, in currency_code.
public.rate_version.currency_code: Currency of unit_price. Join to currency.code for usd_rate.
public.rate_version.change_reason: Why the price changed. Useful when a user asks why a rate moved.
